tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: save and recall a Kit
steps: Back up the project and open a disposable copy in an OctaKit build; old Parts migrate to the first 64 Kit slots.
On MKII, press PART to open LOAD KIT; on MKI, hold FUNC and press MIDI. Select a Kit with UP/DOWN or LEVEL and press YES.
Edit an audio track parameter, then open SAVE KIT with FUNC+PART on MKII or FUNC+BANK on MKI. Choose the destination and press YES; enter a name of up to seven characters and confirm.
Hold FUNC and press CUE to reload the saved Kit and discard subsequent unsaved edits. Use LOAD KIT > UNDO KIT to return to the last loaded Kit.
